title: attest_peer() builds the same Unattested fallback twice in a nested match
close_reason: ALREADY FIXED, verified 2026-09-15. The duplicated ConsumerIdentity::Unattested fallback is gone -- grep for 'Unattested' across the workspace returns nothing; the variant no longer exists. hire-grpc/src/consumer_attest.rs attest_peer now propagates with ? and returns Result<ConsumerIdentity, AttestError>, and the module header records why there is no unattested fallback at all: a pid-keyed identity changes every launch and a uid-keyed one is shared by everything the user runs, so refusing removes the choice instead of making the wrong one.
